name: Update an email template
description: Update an email template. Update an existing transactional email template by its numeric ID or custom template identifier string. All fields in the request body are optional; only the provided fields will be updated. You can update the template name, subject, sender, reply-to address, HTML content (via `htmlContent` or `htmlUrl`), active status, tag, attachment URL, and the personalized `toField`. Only one of sender email or sender ID should be provided per request.

templateId.description: ID of the template. Can be a numeric template ID or a custom template identifier string.

attachmentUrl.description: Absolute url of the attachment (**no local file**). Extensions allowed: #### xlsx, xls, ods, docx, docm, doc, csv, pdf, txt, gif, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, rtf, bmp, cgm, css, shtml, html, htm, zip, xml, ppt, pptx, tar, ez, ics, mobi, msg, pub and eps

htmlContent.description: **Required if htmlUrl is empty**. If the template is designed using Drag & Drop editor via HTML content, then the design page will not have Drag & Drop editor access for that template. Body of the message (HTML must have more than 10 characters)

htmlUrl.description: **Required if htmlContent is empty**. URL to the body of the email (HTML)

isActive.description: Status of the template. isActive = false means template is inactive, isActive = true means template is active

replyTo.description: Email on which campaign recipients will be able to reply to

id.description: Select the sender for the template on the basis of sender id. _In order to select a sender with specific pool of IP’s, dedicated ip users shall pass id (instead of email)_.

sender.description: Sender details including id or email and name (_optional_). Only one of either Sender's email or Sender's ID shall be passed in one request at a time. For example: **{"name":"xyz", "email":"example@abc.com"}** **{"name":"xyz", "id":123}**
